start_here: Say to your AI: "List the newest videos of each channel, tab or playlist I name and keep each new video's captions with the times they are said, its description and, if I ask, its top comments, without downloading any video", with {"seeds":["@samplechannel"],"newest":1,"caption_languages":["en.*"],"budget_seconds":1}. It runs tool:keep-channels-latest-videos-and-captions and answers {"stopped":"budget","requests":0,"seconds":0,"seeds":[],"captions":{"ready":0,"empty":0,"failed":[]},"comments":0,"settled":0,"again":{"seeds":["@samplechannel"],"newest":1,"caption_languages":["en.*"],"budget_seconds":1,"skip_ids":[]}}
no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it takes its input and keeps only its own rows (record:sources) through the records door.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "List the newest videos of each channel, tab or playlist I name and keep each new video's captions with the times they are said, its description and, if I ask, its top comments, without downloading any video", and give it seeds (Channels (@handle, channel id or link), links to a channel's tab, or playlist links; or { seed, id, newest }: id is the row this seed updates when rows are one per seed (no rows.id needed when every seed has one), newest is how many of this seed's videos to keep); newest (How many of each seed's newest videos to keep; left out only when every seed carries its own newest); caption_languages (Caption languages in the order wanted, as the site writes them (* for any ending, for example en.*)).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:keep-channels-latest-videos-and-captions and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: For each seed (a channel's @handle, id or link, a link to one of its tabs such as /shorts, or a playlist link) lists the newest `newest` videos with yt-dlp on this computer, then fetches the captions (in the first of caption_languages the video has; json3, else WebVTT), the site's description and, with also ["comments"], the top comments_per_video comments of every listed video not in skip_ids.
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: record:sources (records:read, records:write).
